en.name: Thigh Lift (Thighplasty)
en.meta_title: Thigh Lift Surgery (Thighplasty): Inner & Outer Thigh Contouring
en.meta_description: Address loose, sagging skin on the thighs with a thigh lift (thighplasty). This body contouring procedure removes excess skin and fat to create a firmer, smoother, and more youthful thigh contour.
en.meta_keywords: thigh lift, thighplasty, inner thigh lift, sagging skin removal, body contouring, post-weight loss surgery, plastic surgery

what_is.heading: What is a Thigh Lift? Contouring Your Legs
paragraphs: A thigh lift, or thighplasty, is a body contouring procedure that addresses loose, sagging skin and excess fat on the inner and/or outer thighs. This condition is a common result of massive weight loss, aging, or genetics and can cause both cosmetic dissatisfaction and physical issues like chafing and irritation.

procedure.heading: The Thighplasty Procedure
paragraphs: A thigh lift creates a firmer, smoother, and more youthful thigh contour. During the procedure, an incision is made, typically in the groin crease extending down the inner thigh, through which excess skin and fat are removed. The remaining skin is then redraped and tightened, resulting in a significantly improved leg shape.

candidates_recovery.heading: Candidates and Recovery
paragraphs: Ideal candidates are at a stable weight and are committed to maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Recovery involves wearing compression garments and avoiding strenuous activity for about 4-6 weeks. While a scar will be present, our surgeons place it as discreetly as possible. The final result is beautifully contoured legs that you will be proud to show off.
